newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul NLCF buys 52,500T more corn, 40,000T soymeal.
newsitem.headline: Seoul NLCF buys 52,500T more corn, 40,000T soymeal.

text.p: South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said it had bought an additional 52,500 tonnes of Argentine feed corn on Friday which had been passed on earlier that day.
It said it also bought 40,000 tonnes of Brazilean soymeal last week.
An official with the federation said it bought a total of 157,500 tonnes of corn from Argentina on Friday.

The official said it divided the total into three lots of 52,500 tonnes each. The first was awarded to Cargill at $159.75 per tonne, C&F, with shipment for April 16-May 5, and the second went to Peavey at $158.05 per tonne, C&F, with shipment for May 26-June 14.
Cargill also won the third contract late Friday at $159.75 per tonne, C&F, with shipment for March 31-April 19.
The arrival ports were set for Inchon, Pusan, Ulsan and Kunsan.
Deliveries were set for June 10 for the first shipment, July 20 for the second and May 25 for the third.
The official also said it bought 40,000 tonnes of Brazilean soymeal at $299 per tonne, C&F. He said Daewoo won the contract for shipment between March 1 and 20.
